derivation: Dropped the Sun (id 0) and stars without usable parallax (dist ≥ 100000). Kept equatorial cartesian x/y/z (pc), apparent magnitude, and B−V; tiled by distance shell. Star color is derived from B−V at render time (bv-to-rgb).
